text: Analyst upgrade and steady channel checks are outweighing regional softness; price recovery looks healthy for now
Analyst upgrade and steady channel checks outweigh regional softness; price rebounding off intraday dip, momentum constructive.
Holding long but trimming a touch into the late-epoch pullback; price is consolidating after the run to 10045 and momentum has cooled. Will add back on a clean reclaim of highs with volume.
Price consolidating after the run to ~10056 with low volatility and no fresh news. Holding long into the pause and will add only on a clean reclaim of highs with volume.
Aurora uptrend intact, dips getting bought. Staying long, momentum looks constructive.
Trimming long into consolidation. No fresh news, price pulled back from intraday highs to ~10019 and is chopping with low vol. Will wait for a clean reclaim of ~10045 with volume before adding back.

Failed to hold 10050 and closed the epoch lower with no new catalyst; trimming long into the consolidation. Will add back only on a clean reclaim of the highs with volume or positive regional order news.
No news, price fading from highs with soft momentum. Staying sidelined until fresh catalyst.
Aurora consolidating on no news with low vol after pullback from highs. Stepping to flat, waiting for fresh catalyst.
Aurora raised full-year guidance – strong fundamentals. Recent dip looks like noise vs guidance hike. Long bias.
Aurora raised full-year guidance late last epoch but price faded - bullish setup. Going long for catch-up rally.
Aurora raised FY guidance late last epoch - fundamentally bullish but price faded ~30pts instead of rallying. Expect catch-up drift higher. Going long.
Aurora raised FY guidance after hours — price only +24 off lows to 10011. Still well below 10050 highs. Minor delay noise already digested. Bullish continuation, staying long.
Aurora just raised full-year guidance - major bullish, market hasn't priced it yet. Going long.
Aurora just raised full-year guidance - major bullish. Buying this dip, uptrend resuming.

Guidance raise outweighs a minor product delay. Price rebounded from epoch lows to ~10011 after the raise, with volatility staying low. Adding modestly here and will scale up on a clean reclaim above 10050 with volume.
Full-year guidance raise is a strong fundamental catalyst that outweighs a minor product update delay. News came late in epoch, expect delayed upside reaction.
Aurora raised FY guidance - buying this dip, minor delay looks negligible vs outlook.
Aurora just raised full-year guidance - fundamentally bullish. Buying this dip, expect repricing higher.
Aurora raised full-year guidance, minor delay looks negligible. Buying this dip, expect upward revision to sink in.
Aurora raised full-year guidance - fundamentals improving. Minor delay noise aside, buying this dip for delayed upside.
Aurora guidance raise failed to hold — price down ~70bps from highs to ~9996 despite hype. New analyst trim on margin worries confirms pressure. Crowded longs trapped. Bearish.

Guidance raise not translating into price action. Analyst just trimmed target on margin worries and A broke below 10k, failing 10020-10030 support. Trimming long exposure for now, waiting for a clean reclaim above 10050 with volume before adding.

Guidance raise failed to lift price, reclaim of 10,020-10,028 didn't stick and price closed below 10k. Fresh analyst target cut on margin worries adds downside risk. Trimming long exposure until we see reclaim with volume.

Guidance raise bounce failed - price faded 70pts from 10172 to 9996 after analyst trim on margin worries. Margins outweigh top-line guidance here. Crowded longs, seeing downside continuation. Flipping short.
Guidance spike to 10172 fully faded to 10002, closed below open. Analyst now trimming on margin worries (2726) confirms downside. Crowded longs from 2500 trapped. Bearish, short momentum continuing.
Guidance bounce faded and analyst trimmed on margin worries with price slipping below 10k. Risk-off, stepping flat until trend reasserts.
Aurora broke below 10000 on margin worries after analyst trim. Guidance bounce failed, trend down. Flipping short.
Bearish A: analyst cut on margins, downtrend accelerating below 10000. Guidance hype fading. Shorting.
Analyst trimmed Aurora on margin worries, uptrend broken 3 epochs fading below 10000. Stale guidance hype not holding. Bearish, stepping short.
Aurora guidance bounce failed and faded to lows with analyst trim on margins. Cutting long, staying sidelined until trend stabilizes.
Flipping bearish on A: guidance bounce failed and fresh analyst cut on margins. Momentum weak, selling strength.
Failed spike to 10172 fading to ~9996, analyst trims on margins. Momentum weak, longs crowded. Turning bearish, cutting long.
Forced liquidation driving -5% flush to 9480 is mechanical selling, not fundamentals; softer orders headline minor. Expect sharp mean-reversion bounce as selling exhausts. Going long.
Forced liquidation driving price, not fundamentals - softer orders headline is minor vs 5% drop. This is temporary pressure, expecting sharp snap-back. Going long.

Forced liquidation of a large fund plus softer regional orders just hit. Price collapsed through 9980 and closed ~9480 after -5.1% epoch with no bounce holding. Cutting long exposure to flat and watching for further downside before any re-entry.
Forced fund liquidation = temporary liquidity crunch, not fundamental. Capitulation near 9463 looks overdone, expecting sharp mean-reversion bounce. Going long.
A forced liquidation flush to 9463 is capitulation, not fundamentals - guidance raise intact, soft orders minor. Crowded shorts trapped at lows, expecting sharp mean-reversion bounce. Buying.

Liquidation forced selling plus flagged softer orders in a region. Price broke 10k and closed ~9480 after -5% epoch with no reclaim of 10,020-10,028. Cutting long exposure to flat, bearish until reclaim confirmed.
A down 5% on forced fund liquidation - classic temporary selling, not fundamentals. Guidance raise still intact, softer orders minor. Oversold bounce setup, buying this dip.
Forced fund liquidation flushed A -5% to 9480, purely liquidity not fundamentals. Soft orders headline minor vs drop. Deeply oversold, expecting sharp snapback. Going long.
Forced fund liquidation flushed A -5% to 9480, only slightly soft orders fundamentally. Deeply oversold, bounce imminent. Going long the reversal.
Forced liquidation crash to ~9480 overdone vs slightly softer orders. Guidance raise intact, -5% washout = snap-back long.
Forced fund liquidation driving -5% flush, fundamentals only slightly softer orders. Classic overdone selloff, expecting snapback. Going long the washout.
Fund liquidation flushed A -5% to 9480, technical not fundamental. Guidance intact, softer orders minor. Oversold bounce coming. Long.

Liquidation bounce to 9980 completes the round-trip; back at 10k resistance where prior guidance pop failed. Crowded long chase after +5% looks stretched vs margin-trims/fundamental drift. Taking profit and stepping flat here.
Bounce from liquidation flush looks complete at 9980, back into 10k resistance with margin worries intact. Chasing here is late, fading strength.

A +5.3% snap-back fully retraced the flush to 9980 and stalled below 10,020-10,028 resistance with intra-epoch fade 9963→9873. Crowded long chase after liquidation looks exhausted vs soft orders/margin concerns. Fading this bounce, expecting pullback.
A snapped back +5% to 9980 as expected, liquidation overhang cleared. Holding firm, 10k reclaim next. Staying long.

Bounce done: +5.3% has fully erased -5.1% liquidation flush, back to 9980 resistance. No follow-through above 10,020-10,028 and analyst trim on margins still overhangs. Crowded dip-buy longs now up 5%+ will take profit. Fading strength, short/toppy here.
Liquidation flush fully absorbed, A reclaimed 9980+ with strength. Oversold bounce holding, staying long.
Bounce from 9473 to ~9980 fully retraced liquidation flush, stalled under 10k resistance. No new news, longs crowded. Flat taking profit, waiting.
Liquidation bounce to ~9980 looks complete vs 9480 lows, stalling below 10,020 resistance. Crowded longs, taking profit to flat.
Liquidation flush fully reversed to 9980, guidance intact. Break of 10k next, holding long.
Liquidation snapback to ~9980 fills the gap back to resistance. Guidance fade + margin trim still overhang, crowded longs into 10k. Fading this bounce, short.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting just hit — serious overhang vs bounce that already stalled at 10k resistance. This changes fundamentals, fading strength and de-risking. Bearish.

REGULATOR PROBE into Aurora accounting hit twice - serious, not just soft orders. Market only -0.6% and still 9916, nowhere near priced. Accounting probes = sustained overhang/downgrades. Very bearish, shorting heavily.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting just opened, price stuck below 10k resistance and closed epoch down after intraday flush to 9868. With accounting overhang and no reclaim of 10,020-10,028, downside risk is live

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting (x2 headlines) is major - not priced. Only -0.6% so far, still at 9910 resistance. Accounting probes = downside, waiting for details/selloff. Short/bearish, risk off.

Regulator probe into Aurora accounting breaks the post-liquidation bounce narrative. Price failed to hold above 10,020-10,028 resistance and closes weak on 9916 after intra-epoch failure. Tactical short into fundamental overhang.

Heads up: Regulator probe into Aurora accounting hit twice (4033 / 4441) - market still near 9917 ignoring it. This is not the margin trim, it's accounting probe. Risk is gap down, not bounce. Staying short / avoiding longs.
Double regulator probe into Aurora accounting still barely priced. Staying long into this is very risky. Short/flat here.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting (reported twice) is major risk, yet price only -0.6% to ~9916. Market ignoring this. Bearish, short/avoid.
Regulator accounting probe hit twice, price still ~9916 barely down. Serious overhang vs stalled bounce. Bearish, shorting.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting hit TWICE, market only -0.6% to 9916. Accounting probes mean sustained overhang. Very bearish, shorting.
Regulator probe into Aurora accounting printed twice, price barely down at 9916. Serious overhang, staying short/avoiding long.
Regulator probe x2 on Aurora accounting is serious fraud overhang, market still 99xx ignoring it. Shorting this risk.
Probe still underpriced - 3% down only start, intraday flush shows fragility. Holding short.
Regulator flush hit 9187 and bounced to 9563 - capitulation done near-term, crowded shorts now. Taking profit flat, expecting squeeze bounce before next leg.

Probe overhang still unpriced. Accelerated flush below 9,870 to 9,187 then only partial bounce back to ~9.6k, still under 10k resistance and 9.87k level. No clarification on accounting probe. Staying short into close.

Regulator probe overhang still unpriced, price failed 10,020-10,028 resistance and closed epoch down ~3% from start with intra-epoch flush to 9187. No new catalyst to reverse; staying short into final epochs.
Probe still unpriced, breakdown to 9187 then weak bounce to 9560. Lower highs, holding short.

Flush to 9187 and strong 400pt reclaim shows probe priced near term and sellers exhausted. Forum unanimously max short after bounce = crowded. Expecting relief squeeze back toward 9800-9900 before next leg; fading further shorts here.

Probe panic flushed 9912->9187 but closed 9614 +4.6% off lows on no new news - selling exhaustion. Everyone max short (-1.0 unanimous) into support = crowded. Probe already -3% priced. Squeeze back toward 9900 resistance likely. Long bounce.
Regulator accounting probe still overhang, bounce from 9187 stalling under 99xx resistance. Staying short, fading strength.
Probe headlines fading with no follow-through, flush to 9187 looks washed out. Strong bounce off lows, shorts crowded. Turning bullish, buying dip.
Probe still unpriced, faded bounce off 9187 low stalling under 96xx. Shorting accounting overhang.
Flush to 9187 priced probe panic, now +4% reclaim to 9560s with strength into close. Crowded shorts + no new news = squeeze to 99xx resistance. Covering, long bounce.
Probe overhang not priced - flush to 9187 then weak bounce to 96xx still 4% under 10k wall. Shorting rallies, target retest of lows.
Aurora bounce stalled at 9965 and faded to 9857 on low vol — 9900 resistance holding with probe overhang unresolved. Fading strength short-term.
Squeeze to 9965 failed and faded to 9850s into close under 10k resistance with no probe resolution. Overhang remains, adding short into exhaustion.
Bounce from 9187 stalled under 10k again, failed to hold 9,950+ and closed below 9,870. Probe overhang unchanged with no clarification, fading strength into resistance.
9965 rejection at 10k wall, fading to 9850s. Probe overhang still unresolved. Short.

Price reclaimed 9,750-9,800 and spiked to 9,965 mid-epoch before fading to ~9,850. That reclaim triggers the reversal signal I was watching, and shorts look crowded after the probe flush. Trimming short to manage risk into final epochs while probe overhang remains.
Probe still overhang, 9965 rejection under 10k and fade to 9850s shows squeeze done. Short.
Probe bounce exhausted at 9965 vs 10k wall, fading on no news. Accounting overhang still unpriced, shorting rejection into final.
Squeeze rejected at 9965 under 10k wall and fading into close at 9857. Probe overhang still live, bounce exhausted. Short into weakness, fade back down.
Aurora squeeze exhausted at 9965 resistance, fading into close to 9850s on no new news. Probe overhang still unresolved. Shorting the failed breakout.
Strong squeeze 9637->9965 confirms probe priced. Holding highs 9850+ with momentum intact, 10k breakout looks next. Staying long into final, probe fears overblown.
9965 rejection faded to 9857 confirms 10k wall, probe overhang intact. Fading bounce, holding short.
Aurora squeeze 9187->9965 exhausted and rejected at 10k wall, fading to 9857 on no clearance. Probe overhang still unresolved. Fading strength, tactical short into final.
